prompt: In some countries, there is not enough respect for elderly people. What are the causes of this? Suggest some solutions.
essay:
Today, in some countries, many people above the age of sixty are not being treated with enough respect. In this essay, I will give reasons why this is happening and possible solutions to prevent this issue from worsening.

One primary reason for this phenomenon is that many countries are not properly educating the younger generation about manners and respect. Children and adults may have never been taught that treating an older person a specific way is unethical. To illustrate, I have never been taught to address the elderlyin aspecific way until very recently. Simply speaking, many of the disrespectful actions may not always be intentional, but rather it is just not knowing how older people should be treated.

In addition, elderly people not receiving enough respect could also be because they are viewed as vulnerable and less intimidating. It is often believed that older people have less authority, and therefore, giving them the respect they deserve would not be necessary.

One possible solution is to provide better education for children about respect and etiquette towards older people. This change will, as a result, help the youth understand what they should be doing to treat the elderly respectfully and correctly. Consequently, as more people are aware of what should be done, this problem will be less common. As well as this, governments could create a law that penalises people who disrespect seniors. This is one solution that can be implemented in countries because it will make their views towards the elderly less negative.

In conclusion, it is clear that many seniors are not given enough respect they deserve because the younger generation may see them as weak or are not always properly educated. However, this issue can be solved. The education system can teach people about respect towards older people, and governments can create strict laws on this problem. Given the situation, it is important for us to work together and help the elderly get the respect they deserve.
